tasks.goal: Prove the staged capture/export/Linux evidence handoff path before UI team takeover.
tasks.remaining_constraint: The staged path is green. Realtime streaming and corpus scoring remain separate tasks.

tasks.goal: Define the minimum tests required before handing Fox Say to a UI/native team.
Expose Fox and Fox Say as two independent iPad home-screen apps while sharing the same native WKWebView shell.
Provide one command that checks latest capture, exports it to VCompose, submits the Linux staged smoke gate, polls the report, and emits a single handoff summary.
Collect and score 50-100 real human/iPad/noise samples.
Implement the safe bridge from Linux ASR results to Fox review drafts and manually confirmed Entries.
boundary: ASR text does not mutate workout state
raw audio paths are not exposed in Entry evidence

tasks.goal: Make Fox Say usable as a voice draft inbox before introducing automatic command admission.
capabilities: list pending and historical voice drafts
edit entry type, title, confirmation text, and structured JSON
boundary: confirmed and discarded drafts are not returned to pending work by the UI
ASR text still does not mutate workout state
LLM extraction is not yet wired into draft creation

tasks.goal: Make Fox Say understandable and testable before adding LLM extraction or realtime voice control.
capabilities: three workspaces: daily record, link test, inbox
daily stepper for capture, ASR, draft, review, and Entry
completion receipt showing Entry, kind, raw audio boundary, and workout-state boundary
debug-only area for TTS, browser speech recognition, corpus capture, and policy diagnostics
boundary: test mode uses fake local capture and guided-test ASR evidence
real Linux ASR is still staged through npm run say:linux-asr

tasks.goal: Run the latest iPad recording through Linux SenseVoice and post the transcript back to Fox ASR evidence.
tasks.remaining_constraint: This is a staged latest-capture path, not realtime streaming or automatic workout command admission.

tasks.goal: Replace staged upload/export with realtime iPad -> Linux streaming and measure short command latency.
tasks.why_not_now: This is a higher-complexity runtime path and should be measured after the staged capture handoff is stable.

tasks.goal: Play Linux-generated or cached TTS audio back on the iPad instead of relying on browser speechSynthesis.
tasks.why_not_now: Browser speechSynthesis is only a basic fallback; natural voice should be wired through a separate Linux TTS playback gate.

tasks.goal: Admit Linux ASR text into the Fox workout state machine for commands, corrections, and review notes.
tasks.why_not_now: This touches product behavior and safety; ASR text must pass a typed command gate before mutating workout state.
blocked_actions: automatic workout state mutation from unverified ASR text

tasks.goal: Turn Fox Say from a handoff/evidence path into a daily-use voice product with polished native UI and resilient runtime lifecycle.
tasks.why_not_now: This combines UI polish, realtime runtime, state mutation, and benchmark evidence; it should follow the narrower runtime gates.

tasks.goal: Let another team build the iPad/native UI and streaming bridge using the current contracts.
blocked_actions: automatic workout state mutation from ASR text
